correctness.rationale: The complete derivative computation forces the singular points to the two roots of Q and the three simple zeros of each explicit cubic h_r. The étale local parameter change gives exact completed A2 normal form ts+u^3, proving normality and the K3 resolution. The residual pencil has two triple lines with three two-curve resolution chains each (affine E6, IV*), plus nodes at four G-roots and 0/infinity (six I1); a derivative check excludes other bad fibers. The Frobenius formula establishes pure inseparability. The standalone GF9 certificate proves open-condition nonemptiness, not the infinite theorem.
